works.author: Techwitpro UI/UX
works.comment: SaaS 招聘落地页：信息密度和 CTA 层级处理干净，hero+信任背书的排版值得参考。
works.comment_en: SaaS hiring landing page: clean info density and CTA hierarchy, with a hero-plus-social-proof layout worth referencing.
works.title: A Smarter Way to Hire Top Talent

works.author: Jack R. for RonDesignLab ⭐️
works.comment: AI 货运管理平台：地图+状态时间线的组合布局，复杂数据也塞得有条理。
works.comment_en: AI shipment-management platform: the map-plus-status-timeline combo keeps complex data orderly.
works.title: ShipLens SaaS – AI Shipment Management Platform

works.author: Roohi Web
works.comment: 时尚电商落地页：大图留白+细线排版，品牌感拉得很满，DTC 站点可借鉴。
works.comment_en: Fashion e-commerce landing page: big imagery, whitespace, and hairline typography — full brand presence, worth borrowing for DTC sites.
works.title: Stylvane – Fashion E-commerce Landing Page

works.author: BayFi UI/UX®
works.comment: 房地产投资组合看板：KPI 卡+多图表组合的密度控制做得好，深色方案干净。
works.comment_en: Real estate portfolio dashboard: well-controlled density across KPI cards and chart combos, in a clean dark theme.
works.title: DOMEXA - Real Estate Portfolio Analytics Dashboard

works.author: George Railean
works.comment: AI 策略管控平台看板：1165 赞的硬核作品，规则引擎+监控的交互信息架构很值得学。
works.comment_en: AI policy-control dashboard: a hardcore piece with 1,165 likes — the rules-engine-plus-monitoring IA is well worth studying.
works.title: AI Dashboard Design for Control AI Policy Platform

works.author: BayFi UI/UX®
works.comment: 现代外卖 App UI：菜品卡片的图+价+加购三层布局顺手，移动端商品流的优秀模板。
works.comment_en: Modern food-delivery app UI: dish cards layer image, price, and add-to-cart in a natural flow — an excellent mobile product-feed template.
works.title: Mealio – Modern Food Delivery App UI/UX
